description: Send a limit order's create or cancel step AFTER the maker's own wallet signed it (from create_limit_order or cancel_limit_order): the signed Solana transaction, or the EIP-712 signature of an EVM order. This only relays what the wallet signed; The LayerHop MCP server holds no private keys and never signs or broadcasts transactions.

signature.description: EVM: the wallet's eth_signTypedData_v4 signature of typedData.

name: submit_limit_order
title: Submit a signed limit order or cancellation
